Class UltraHdrTileSink

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.sink.AbstractTileSink
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.sink.AbstractDelegatingTileSink
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.ultrahdr.UltraHdrTileSink
All Implemented Interfaces:
TileSink, AutoCloseable
@AutoService(TileSink.class) public class UltraHdrTileSink extends AbstractDelegatingTileSink implements AutoCloseable
A TileSink decorator that integrates the UltraHDR gain map into every tile: the delegate sink renders the primary tile, the gain map for the tile region is cropped from the HdrFrame the Tiler attaches through the metadata map (see HdrFrame.META_FRAME), re-encoded, and the ultrahdr WASM codec assembles both into an UltraHDR JPEG that is written to the real output stream.

Gain maps stay transparent to sources: when the frame carries one (UltraHDR input) it is cropped through the primary/gainmap resolution ratio; when it does not (true-HDR input such as JXL PQ/HLG) one is derived in-sink (see HdrGainMapDeriver) before assembly. Tiles from sources without any HDR content pass through unchanged (no frame is attached).

info.json: always advertises https://christianmahnke.de/iiif/hdr/ (V3 service + extraFeatures, V2 supports entry).

Options (via --sink-opt):

  • delegate — name of the delegate sink (default: default).
  • format — tile format (default: jpg; handled by the base class).
  • runtime — WASM engine selection: auto (default), chicory, or graalvm.
  • quality — JPEG quality for the primary image re-encode (default: 90).
  • gainmap-quality — JPEG quality for the gain map re-encode (default: 85).
  • threads — parallel assembly lanes (default: one per available processor capped at 4; 1 selects serial execution). Each lane pairs one interpreter instance with its own thread; -Dwasm.lanes=N sets the default when unset.

Threading: the Tiler generates tiles concurrently; all WASM access is routed through the GainMapCodec's lane pool (one lane per available processor capped at 4 by default, serial with threads=1).

    • supportsHdr

      public boolean supportsHdr()
      Opts into HDR: the Tiler attaches the source's HdrFrame to every tile's metadata, which this sink crops (or derives a gain map from) for assembly.

      The attached frame is shared by reference across the tile tasks of one source image and only read from, so concurrent crops are safe; building it costs one cached float frame per source image.

      Specified by:
      supportsHdr in interface TileSink

    • getInfoJsonExtension

      public TileSink.InfoExtension getInfoJsonExtension(ImageInfo.IIIFVersion version)
      Advertises UltraHDR support in info.json via HDR_PROFILE_URI.
      • V3: prepends HDR_CONTEXT_URI to @context, adds a service entry and an extraFeatures entry.
      • V2: adds the profile URI to the embedded profile supports list (plain URI entries are allowed by the V2 spec).
      Specified by:
      getInfoJsonExtension in interface TileSink
